retros_opened: RETRO-JEPA-V20-NO-DATA: Exp 781 blocked because CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE not set in CI environment. n_labeled=0 — no live data collected. JEPA v20 retrain (Exp 783) ran on only 18 EDU-PRM-selected pairs from the v19 corpus, producing ood_auc=0.4467 which is WORSE than v19 (0.5667). Root cause: data starvation. Fix: run Exp 781 with CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE=1 on RTX 3090 to collect live pairs before next retrain.

RETRO-CONSTRAINT-ZERO-DELTA: Exp 788 constraint_addition_delta=0.0. Dynamic (memory-augmented) IsingEBM equals static baseline (static_accuracy=dynamic_accuracy=0.40 vs oracle=0.60). Constraint addition from error patterns not improving accuracy. Root cause: synthetic patterns too coarse (carry/sign/unit errors encoded as scalar penalty, not structured constraint). Next: use real embedding-based constraint retrieval instead of keyword pattern counts.

RETRO-KV260-TOOLS-UNAVAILABLE: Exp 791 yosys=False, nextpnr_ice40=False, icepack=False — all three open-source FPGA tools absent from PATH. Synthesis blocked at tool-check stage. Fix: install yosys + nextpnr-ice40 + icestorm via system package manager before milestone .61 KV260 experiments.
retros_still_open: RETRO-028: Gemma4 loader CUDA OOM — Exp 786 blocked_no_live_gpu (CI env, not OOM). RETRO-028 remains unresolved for live GPU runs. Requires kill_gpu_zombies() before Gemma4 load on 24 GiB card.
RETRO-JEPA-OOD-V20: ood_auc=0.4467 in v20 — REGRESSION vs v19 (0.5667). Root cause: v20 retrained on only 18 EDU-PRM pairs (no new live data). Need CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE=1 run first.

RETRO-SOTA-GGUF-TIMEOUT: Exp 785 timed out again at 90 min — second consecutive milestone timeout for SOTA GGUF code repair. Prerequisite: RETRO-028 must close (live GPU path) before this experiment can complete.

milestone_wins: Wall-time improvement: 110.25 min vs 128.48 min (.59) — 18.24 min saved, first improvement after .59 regression.
EDU-PRM step selection (Exp 782): uncertainty_selected_pct=0.316 exceeds 0.30 gate — corpus selection method validated.
S* energy prefilter (Exp 787): energy_correct_rank_pct=0.70, tests_saved_pct=0.75 on 20 CPU-only problems — energy ranking eliminates 75% of test oracle calls.
EBM calibration (Exp 789): ECE reduced from 0.3165 to 0.1026 via isotonic regression (67.6% ECE improvement) — calibrated confidence scores now available.
NPU mlir-aie installed (Exp 790): option_a_success=True, mlir_aie importable — Xilinx NPU toolchain unblocked, awaiting Vitis for GEMM benchmark.
Gate governance: Exp 784 correctly blocked tier35 deployment when ood_auc=0.4467 < 0.75 — governance working without human intervention.

Exp 785 TIMEOUT: SOTA GGUF code repair timed out again (90 min) — second consecutive milestone failure. RETRO-028 prerequisite unresolved.
Exp 786 BLOCKED: Gemma4 OOM fix blocked_no_live_gpu — RETRO-028 unresolved for third+ milestone.
